source_policy.promotion_rule: Discovery-source headlines never create high-confidence eligibility by themselves. High-confidence qualification requires auditable company/government/tender/rating/regulator evidence or resolved underlying-source corroboration.
source_policy.aggregator_rule: GDELT and Google News are discovery/coverage layers. Neither aggregator title alone can be treated as primary evidence.
source_policy.degraded_run_rule: If GDELT or Google News health fails, the source stage fails rather than silently substituting one for the other.
source_policy.duplicate_rule: Duplicate stories across aggregators are collapsed; cross-source agreement is corroboration, not multiple independent catalysts.

gdelt.doc_api_role: disabled for production gating because anonymous DOC API throttling is not reliable
gdelt.historical_role: raw GAL/GKG archive or BigQuery for point-in-time backtests
